subject: FinCorp Dedicated Pools: architecture deep-dive & ops plan
messages:
From: Samuel Lee <samuel.lee@fincorp.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU capacity conversation — request for architecture deep-dive

Hi Evelyn / Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks for the initial call last week. Our infra team dug into the usage logs and we'd like a focused technical deep-dive on the Dedicated pool proposal before procurement signs off. Topics we'd like covered:

- Pool sizing methodology for steady + burst workloads
- Autoscaling behavior and SLO guarantees under heavy tails
- Isolation/tenancy model and network boundaries (we have strict audit controls)
- KV cache persistence during failovers and warm-up expectations

Can you run a 60–75 minute session next week? Prefer mornings (PST). If possible, include an ops runbook outline we can hand to our SREs. Attaching our current usage export for context.

Attachments: fincorp-current-usage-export.csv

Samuel
Director, Cloud Platform
FinCorp
From: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Lee <samuel.lee@fincorp.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated GPU capacity conversation — request for architecture deep-dive

Hi Samuel — thanks for the note and the usage export, that’s helpful. We can do a 75-minute session that combines architecture + ops runbook. Proposed agenda:

1) 10m — goals & current usage review (you + us)
2) 20m — pool sizing approach and simulation example
3) 20m — autoscaling mechanics, cooldowns, and SLO impacts
4) 15m — isolation controls, VPC connectivity, and audit hooks
5) 10m — runbook walkthrough and next steps

Prefer 2027-05-19 at 09:30 PST or 2027-05-20 at 10:00 PST. Which works for your team? I’ll bring Marissa for pool sizing nuance and Karthik for the deployment/ops pieces.

I’ve attached a short proposal and a runbook template for your review ahead of time.

Attachments: redwood-proposal-dedicated-pools-v2.pdf, ops-runbook-template.xlsx

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: prep notes for FinCorp deep-dive

Eve / Karthik / Dev — quick internal sync before confirming with FinCorp. Notes:

- Use the usage export to show two scenarios: (A) steady-state 24/7 baseline and (B) 3x burst events (end-of-month batch).
- Run deck: include a slide with cost vs latency tradeoff for quantization tiers.
- Autoscale: recommend config with 120s cooldown, expedited warm-up via cached prefix sharing across replicas.
- Isolation: clarify that tenant isolation is by GPU pool + NSX segment; bring sample ACLs and audit log retention options (30/90/365 days).
- Bring runbook: bootstrap, drain, failover, postmortem checklist (DEV to add runbook tasks).

Action items:
- Dev: add runbook draft items + expected commands for draining nodes.
- Karthik: prepare simulation charts for two workload patterns (attach JSON outputs).
- Marissa: prepare pool sizing spreadsheet with headroom assumptions.

I'll queue a 30-minute internal rehearsal on Tue 2027-05-18 11:00 PST; please confirm availability.

— Marissa
From: Samuel Lee <samuel.lee@fincorp.com>
To: evelyn_hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FinCorp Dedicated Pools: architecture deep-dive & ops plan

Evelyn / team — 2027-05-19 at 09:30 PST works for our infra and procurement folks. I’m adding ops+procurement@fincorp.com to the thread for calendar invites and compliance questions.

One ask for the deck: can you include sample audit log snippets showing what data is captured for tenant activity? Also if you could note what we would need to sign off on for DMZ/VPC peering that would be great.

Thanks — see you Monday (our side will dial in from the SJC office).

Samuel
